result:
U8 is complete. Summary:

**Token sweep:** Added `--blue-mid` token (`#2e6f9f` light / `#7fb0d6` dark) to `app/globals.css`, replaced all 22 `text-[#2e6f9f]`/`bg-[#2e6f9f]` occurrences across 10 files with `text-blue-mid`/`bg-blue-mid`, and fixed the one remaining stray `text-[#0e3158]` → `text-ink`. `#f4be30` was already fully tokenized from a prior pass. Three hexes were deliberately left (documented, not new decisions): the theme-independent hero gradient, the rich-text color picker palette (user content), and `lib/content.ts` accent data.

**Radius sweep:** Migrated all 39 off-scale radius occurrences (6/5/3/4/7/28/18/10px) to the nearest sanctioned tier (8/12/16), classifying the ambiguous `10px` cases by whether they're nested controls (→12px inset) or standalone cards (→16px). No `rounded-*!` escapes or inline `borderRadius` used or introduced.

**Verification:** `typecheck` clean, `test` 84/84 green, `lint` unchanged from baseline (same pre-existing `studio-composer.tsx` error, no new findings). Full details, decisions, and two flagged items for manual visual review (heatmap squares got visibly rounder; blue-mid dark rendering) are logged in `docs/UX-BOOST-PROGRESS.md` under **U8**.
